messages.text:
"AETHERIA – SECOND GRAPHICS OVERHAUL ATTEMPT

The previous graphics update did not produce the visual improvement requested. The current game still looks almost the same.

This time, make a clearly visible and substantial graphical transformation.

IMPORTANT:
Keep the existing game, gameplay, systems, content, item data and saved progress. Do not rebuild the project or remove features.

1. New 2.5D visual style

- Create detailed 2.5D isometric HD pixel-art graphics.
- Add much more depth, detail and visual richness to the entire world.
- Replace primitive-looking or placeholder-style sprites with polished original pixel-art assets.
- Improve terrain, grass, trees, forests, water, roads, buildings and environmental objects.
- Use consistent lighting, shadows and atmospheric effects.

2. Characters and monsters

- Make player characters approximately 20% smaller on screen.
- Zoom the camera out slightly to show more of the environment.
- Make characters more detailed, with clearly visible armor, weapons, hairstyles and faction wings.
- Make monsters approximately 25% larger and give each monster a distinctive design.
- Improve walking, running, attacking, casting and death animations.

3. Combat and visual effects

- Add more impressive spell effects, weapon effects and impact animations.
- Make class abilities visually distinct.
- Improve boss appearances and attack effects.

4. User interface

- Clearly label HP, MP and EXP bars.
- Add a visible dedicated main-skill button with icon, mana cost and cooldown.
- Improve inventory item icons and equipment appearance.
- Keep mobile controls comfortable and easy to use.

5. Important technical requirements

- Do not simply change colors or scale existing sprites.
- Actually improve or replace the visual assets and rendering where necessary.
- Do not use external copyrighted game assets.
- Optimize for Android performance.
- Preserve all existing game mechanics, balance, maps, regions, classes, equipment, drops, quests and saves.

6. Verification

Show clear visual differences in the actual gameplay, not just on the title screen.
Test the player, monsters, combat, inventory and multiple regions.
Run the build and report exactly which graphics and files were changed.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
